name: nativity-demo
description: Draft website preview for Nativity of the Theotokos Greek Orthodox Church. The site itself has NO dependencies - these are audit tools only.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run catechumens -- --check && npm run ministries -- --check && npm run snap && npm run audit:a11y && npm run audit:reflow
scripts.evo:seed: docker compose -f tools/evo-sandbox/docker-compose.yml exec evo14 php /opt/ntgoc/seed.php && docker compose -f tools/evo-sandbox/docker-compose.yml exec evo35 php /opt/ntgoc/seed.php
